# Model Comparison

## Sequence Representation Models

### ESMC (ESM Cambrian)

**Status:** Latest (2025)  
**Parameters:** 300M, 600M, 6B  
**Training Data:** 2.8B metagenomic sequences  

**Best For:**
- Sequence embeddings and representations
- Function prediction
- Fine-tuning for custom tasks
- Mutation scoring
- Zero-shot variant effect prediction

**Key Features:**
- Trained on metagenomic data (more diverse)
- Log-linear scaling with compute
- Better representations than ESM2
- Supported via Biohub API

**Access:** [Biohub](https://biohub.ai/models/esmc) | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/biohub) | [GitHub](https://github.com/Biohub/esm)

---

### ESM2

**Status:** Previous generation (2023)  
**Parameters:** 8M - 15B  
**Training Data:** 50M UniProt sequences  

**Best For:**
- Legacy workflows
- Projects using existing ESM2 code
- When you have established pipelines

**Key Features:**
- Well-established
- Large community resources
- Lots of published examples

**Migration Note:** ESMC is a drop-in replacement but with some API differences. See [Migration Guide](decision-tree.qmd).

**Access:** [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/facebook/esm2) | [GitHub](https://github.com/facebookresearch/esm)

---

## Structure Prediction Models

### ESMFold2

**Status:** Latest (2025)  
**Architecture:** Stable recurrent folding layers  
**Modes:** Single sequence or MSA-augmented  

**Best For:**
- Protein complex prediction
- Antibody-antigen interactions
- Protein-protein interactions
- Multi-chain systems
- When accuracy is critical

**Key Features:**
- State-of-the-art accuracy
- Inference-time scaling
- Faster than AlphaFold3
- Supports ligand binding

**Input Limits:**
- Single sequence: up to 768 residues
- Complex mode: sum of chains ≤ 768 residues

**Performance:**
- Antibody-antigen: 50-55% DockQ pass rate
- Protein-protein: 70-76% pass rate
- Protein-ligand: 63-66% pass rate

**Access:** [Biohub](https://biohub.ai/models/esmfold2) | [Tutorials](https://biohub.ai/resources/tutorials)

---

### ESMFold2-Fast

**Status:** Latest (2025)  
**Architecture:** Simplified, optimized for speed  

**Best For:**
- High-throughput structure prediction
- Screening large sequence sets
- When speed matters more than maximum accuracy
- Monomer or simple predictions

**Key Features:**
- 50% fewer layers than ESMFold2
- No MSA requirement
- 1.3x faster than ESMFold2
- Minimal accuracy trade-off

**Performance:**
- Antibody-antigen: 50% DockQ pass rate
- Protein-protein: 68% pass rate
- Protein-ligand: 63% pass rate

**Access:** [Biohub](https://biohub.ai/models/esmfold2) | [Tutorials](https://biohub.ai/resources/tutorials)

---

### ESMFold (Original)

**Status:** First generation (2022)  

**Best For:**
- Legacy workflows
- When ESMFold2 is unavailable

**Note:** Use ESMFold2 instead—it's faster and more accurate.

**Access:** [GitHub](https://github.com/Biohub/esm)

---

## Multimodal Models

### ESM3

**Status:** Latest (2025)  
**Modalities:** Sequence, structure, function  

**Best For:**
- De novo protein design
- Sequence generation
- Conditional structure prediction
- Protein engineering

**Key Features:**
- Multimodal (seq + structure + function)
- Can generate from partial inputs
- Great for design workflows

**Access:** [Biohub](https://biohub.ai/models/esm3) | [Paper](https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.adk2211) | [Tutorials](https://biohub.ai/resources/tutorials)

---

## Quick Decision Matrix

| Task | ESMC | ESM2 | ESM3 | ESMFold2 | ESMFold2-Fast |
|------|------|------|------|----------|---------------|
| Get embeddings | ✅ Best | ✅ Good | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Fine-tune model | ✅ Best | ✅ Good | ⚠️ Limited | ❌ | ❌ |
| Predict structure | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ Best | ✅ Fast |
| Design proteins | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ Best | ❌ | ❌ |
| Score mutations | ✅ Best | ✅ Good | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |
| Predict function | ✅ Best | ✅ Good | ⚠️ | ❌ | ❌ |
| High throughput | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ⚠️ | ✅ Best |
| Maximum accuracy | ✅ Good | ✅ Good | ✅ | ✅ Best | ✅ |

---

## Performance Benchmarks

### Structure Prediction (ESMFold2)

**Antibody-Antigen:**
- Single sequence: 50% DockQ ≥ 0.23
- With MSA: 53% DockQ ≥ 0.23
- With 20 loops: 55% DockQ ≥ 0.23

**Protein-Protein:**
- Single sequence: 70% pass rate
- With MSA: 76% pass rate

**Inference Speed (1024 aa):**
- ESMFold2: 15.8 seconds
- ESMFold2-Fast: 9.4 seconds
- AlphaFold3: 20+ seconds

---

## Training Data Comparison

| Model | Size | Source | Diversity |
|-------|------|--------|-----------|
| ESMC | 2.8B sequences | UniRef + JGI + MGnify | High (metagenomic) |
| ESM2 | 50M sequences | UniRef50 | Medium |
| ESM3 | 2.8B sequences | UniRef + metagenomic | High |
